name: OmaColorBar
author: BlackCode
description: OmaColorBar: color icons for Omarchy's built-in bar widgets, tray apps, open apps and weather. Each copy hosts the real widget, so its popup and clicks stay Omarchy's own; settings are read from plugins[]. Sets itself up when enabled. Right-click the logo or press SUPER+CTRL+ALT+C for the settings panel

barWidget.description: One of Omarchy's bar widgets, with a color icon

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Which built-in widget this copy shows. Its popup and clicks stay Omarchy's own. The omarchy.menu copy is locked to the menu.

schema.label: Menu logo
schema.description: For the copy set to omarchy.menu: the Omarchy logo, the Arch Linux logo, or another distro's logo (44 in all), each in its official color.

schema.label: Open apps
schema.description: For the copy set to omarchy.tray: show a color icon for each open app next to the tray.

schema.label: Open apps limit
schema.description: For the copy set to omarchy.tray: how many apps show before the rest go behind +N.

schema.label: Hidden apps
schema.description: For the copy set to omarchy.tray: desktop entry ids to keep out of the row. Apps hidden with a right-click are stored separately and not listed here.

schema.label: Show terminals
schema.description: For the copy set to omarchy.tray: also show terminal apps in the open-apps row.

schema.label: Icon size %
schema.description: Size of the color icons, in percent of Omarchy's icon size. Set for every copy at once from the settings panel.
